title: Time to point P
description: Essential Criteria: The response must provide the correct expression for the time t = √[2√2d/(g(1-μ))] or an equivalent simplified form.

title: Velocity at point B
description: Essential Criteria: The response must provide the correct expression for the takeoff velocity v = √[√2gd(1-μ)] or an equivalent simplified form.

title: Maximum platform length L
description: Essential Criteria: The response must provide the correct expression for the maximum length L = √2d(1-μ) or an equivalent simplified form.

title: Energy or impulse analysis
description: Important Criteria: The solution must correctly apply the work-energy theorem or impulse-momentum theorem to relate forces, displacement, and velocity for the inclined section.

title: Projectile motion setup
description: Important Criteria: The solution must correctly analyze the projectile motion from point B, separating horizontal and vertical components with the correct launch angle (45°).

title: Conservation of energy on horizontal
description: Optional Criteria: The solution may note that velocity remains constant from P to B due to the horizontal, frictionless section (or explicitly state this assumption).

title: Trigonometric simplification
description: Optional Criteria: The solution may correctly simplify sin45° and cos45° to 1/√2 or √2/2 throughout the derivation.

title: Sign error in friction
description: Pitfall Criteria: Deduct points if the friction force is added to the component of gravity down the incline instead of subtracted.

title: Projectile time error
description: Pitfall Criteria: Deduct points if the time of flight for the projectile is incorrectly calculated (e.g., using v/g instead of 2v_y/g).

title: Angle confusion
description: Pitfall Criteria: Deduct points if the launch angle components are swapped (using sin for vertical instead of cos, or vice versa) in the projectile equations.
